title: Localization at a point (Simon 6.8.3(1)): IM restrictions to a ball with bounded masses and boundary masses converging to T⌞B_r(x₀)
statement: Assume (REP), (MR), (IMC), (SL) and (TOOLS); they appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement. (REP), (MR), (IMC), (SL) are the exact frozen statements of cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub and cmc_slice_mass_bounds (dependencies of the grandparent node), and (TOOLS) = (T1) ∧ (T2) ∧ (MM) is the exact frozen statement of cbr_measure_convergence_tools (a dependency of the parent cbr_closure_succ). In words: (REP) a current X ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, with M_W(X) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U has a representation (μ, ξ): μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, μ(W) = M_W(X) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x and α, and X(ω) = ∫ ξ(ω) dμ for ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (plus an Hⁿ-null-set clause not used here); (MR) M_W(X) = R.measure(W) for every IMRep R in open U representing X and every open W; (IMC) (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces, (b) for an IMRep R in open U and a Borel set E there are a current A and an IMRep R′ representing A with carrier R.carrier ∩ E, multiplicity R.mult and orientation R.orient, (c) differences of IM currents are IM, (d) for every IMRep R, |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ⌞R.carrier-a.e. x and all α; (SL) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), U open, with admissible representations (μ, ξ) of X and (μ′, ξ′) of ∂X (measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable fields with a.e. bound |·| ≤ 1) and an L-Lipschitz f there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω) dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ′(η) dμ′, ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) when tsupport η ∩ {f = t} = ∅, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for open W, and an integrated bound; (T1) a sequence of measures with sup_j μ_j(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U (U open) has a subsequence μ_{φ(j)} and a measure μ with μ(K) < ∞ and limsup_j μ_{φ(j)}(K) ≤ μ(K) for compact K ⊆ U (and further properties); (T2) if X_j ⇀ X in 𝒟_k(U), (μ_j, ξ_j) and (μ_X, ξ_X) are admissible representations of X_j and X, μ is finite on compact subsets of U with limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K), f is continuous and μ{f = t} = 0, then ∫_{f<t} ξ_j(ω) dμ_j → ∫_{f<t} ξ_X(ω) dμ_X for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U); (MM) if μ_j(G ∩ {a < f < b}) < ∞, f is continuous and Z_j(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ_j(G ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for t ∈ (a, b), then there is a measurable g ≥ 0 with liminf_j Z_j(t) ≤ g(t) for L¹-a.e. t ∈ (a, b) and ∫_{(a,b)} g ≤ L·liminf_j μ_j(G ∩ {a < f < b}). Let d, P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) with every T_j integer multiplicity, sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure contained in U (boundaryMassOn(T_j, W) = M_W(∂T_j) in degree d + 1), T_j ⇀ T in U, and x₀ ∈ U. Then there are r > 0 with closedBall(x₀, r) ⊆ U, currents S_j ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U), IMReps R′_j in U and A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) such that: R′_j represents S_j and R′_j.carrier ⊆ closedBall(x₀, r); S_j(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from closedBall(x₀, r); sup_j (M(S_j) + M(∂S_j)) < ∞ (total masses in U, M = massOn U); S_j ⇀ A in U; and A(ω) = T(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{d+1}(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ ball(x₀, r).
